description: This file contains functions related to upgrading firmware on Buffalo devices using UBI partitions in OpenWrt. It includes logic for preparing UBI volumes, detecting partition indices, and handling firmware upgrade procedures specific to Buffalo hardware models.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares UBI volumes for Buffalo firmware upgrade, including finding UBI devices, locating 'rootfs_1', attaching UBI if necessary, and removing existing UBI volumes.
